after.label: GATE 2027 exams begin
after.notes: IIT Madras: GATE 2027 exams on 6, 7, 13, 14, 20 and 21 Feb 2027 (forenoon and afternoon sessions). The paper-wise schedule — which day CS is held — will be notified later on the GATE 2027 website.

entries.why: IIT Madras gives 6 Feb 2027 only as the first day of the GATE 2027 exam window (6, 7, 13, 14, 20 and 21 Feb) for all papers; it has not said which day the CS paper is held. As an EXAM row on the CS hub it made the title read "GATE CSE 2027 — Exam Date 6 Feb 2027". Archived and suppressed, so a refresh cannot write a CS exam day on 6 Feb again; the window moves to the OTHER row created below.
